Join an award-winning Niagara Falls tour company with over 25 years of experience and enjoy an unforgettable day and evening tour from Toronto or Niagara Falls. Travel in comfort with a professional guide and discover the beauty, history, and power of Niagara Falls. 

Admire the world-famous Horseshoe Falls, American Falls, and Bridal Veil Falls from the Canadian side, and enjoy free time to explore the area at your own pace. The seasonal boat cruise offers an exciting close-up view of the Falls, while the optional dinner upgrade adds a memorable dining experience overlooking the illuminated Falls. As evening arrives, watch Niagara Falls glow in brilliant colors before enjoying the seasonal nightly fireworks display at 10:00pm (typically May through October & on New Year's Eve). 

Convenient pickups, expert commentary, and designated viewing areas make this a stress-free and unforgettable Niagara Falls experience.
